_doc: Catalog assets that the set plans need and that were not in tools/convert/rips when this was written. Every one of them is from a Cyber Sleuth-family game, and the user approved downloading all remaining Cyber Sleuth CE, Digimon Links, Time Stranger, Next Order (PC + Vita) and Re:Digitize assets on 2026-10-15, so their status is "downloading": this file is now a checklist for mapping the new rips (prefixes CS_, L_, TS_, NO_, RD_ in tools/convert/rips/x/) to the set units, not a request to fetch them. Priority is the first set that uses the asset (1 = re-source Set 1). Sizes are estimates per file.

ts.basis: one Time Stranger rip so far (Gizamon, 4.4 MB)

dwnext.basis: no sample; assumed like Cyber Sleuth
